svg.title: Wiring diagram for the square robot on wheels
svg.text: Wiring diagram for the square robot on wheels
Not bench-tested. If your board has a different name printed on it, use the name on the board.

g.text: NECK · 9 mm hole · 8 wires pass through
2 · SIGNALS (the power for these boards is shown in the drawing above)
NECK · 9 mm hole · 8 wires pass through
SEL jumper removed · signal wire only on pin S

svg.text: Yellow box with a number = terminal on the terminal block.
1 = 5.1 V · 2 = negative · 3 = serial · 4 = pack positive (9 to 12.6 V) · 5 = pack negative
In drawing 2, the motor wires use the same colors as the 6-wire cable (white is shown in gray).
Wire: 20 AWG from the pack to the terminal block, converter, motor driver, and Pi; 22 AWG for the rest; Dupont for signals.
3 A time-delay fuse (T3A) on the positive wire, just after the battery holder.
On the robot, the 3 resistors are attached to the terminal block, between terminals 3 and 2.
